description: This file contains a PHP class that defines the controller logic for the 'Account' module in the OpenCart admin extension. It includes methods for displaying and saving account-related settings within the admin panel.

classes.name: Account
classes.description: Controller class for managing account module settings in the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the account module configuration page with breadcrumbs, headers, footers, and other layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of account module settings via AJAX, including permission checks and JSON response.
